purpose: Define the machine-readable top-level release manifest linking release identity, canonical snapshot, repository manifest, validation evidence, compatibility declarations, distributions and predecessor/rollback metadata.

topics.name: Release Manifest
topics.purpose: Define the machine-readable top-level release manifest linking release identity, canonical snapshot, repository manifest, validation evidence, compatibility declarations, distributions and predecessor/rollback metadata.

semantics.nonauthority_rule: Manifest links authoritative records but does not duplicate/redefine their semantics.
semantics.closure_rule: All required refs resolve exactly within the release evidence/distribution graph.
semantics.reader_rule: A generic reader can begin from Release Manifest and deterministically discover the released canonical snapshot and its evidence.
semantics.serialization_rule: Manifest filename/path is not release identity.

invariants.rule: Release, replacement, rollback, deprecation and compatibility decisions remain explicit, snapshot-bound and traceable; no lifecycle label silently changes canonical semantics.

hard_gates.condition: manifest points to stale/mismatched evidence snapshot
